description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 521203
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, addresses, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights in specific locations (Mailawalana village, Gampaha District), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification category.
